Visibility is the primary principle for the JMC logo. The logo must remain highly clear and legible against any background. Our logo is available in three color versions: Full-color logo (JMC Red) Reversed logo (JMC White) Solid black logo (JMC Black) When selecting the logo color, refer to the back- ground grayscale guide to ensure maximum readability. Always use the logo color with the highest contrast against the background.
